notes: CFTC 'Financial Data for FCMs' report for April 30, 2025 (2 pages, 1008 x 612 pt legal pages shown in landscape, PScript5 / Acrobat Distiller 25, untagged), as served; not cut. CFTC's listing gives the as-of date only; the file is in the June 2025 upload folder and its Last-Modified is June 6, 2025 (see holdout5/SELECTION.md). Page 1: the print title, one ruled table of 63 numbered firms, a 'Totals' row and update rows ('March Web Page Update' 63, 'Additions' None, 'Deletions' None, 'Name Changes' None, 'April Web Page Update' 63). Page 2: the print title again and the notes for columns (a)-(q), written inside the ruled grid. Headings: none (a printed worksheet). Table: one PARTIAL table: the header row (two-line header cells written joined with single spaces), the column-letter row ('(a)' under 'Registered As', '(b)' under 'DSRO', none under 'As of Date' and 'Adjusted Net Capital', '(c)'-'(q)' under the next 15 columns), firm rows 1-15 and the 'Totals' row (its label is in the firm-name column; the row-number, registration, DSRO, date and the three capital columns are empty). The empty spacer row between the letter row and row 1 is left out (empty rows are not scored). The apostrophe in "Customers' Assets in Seg" and "Customers' Seg Required 4d(a)(2)" is written as an ASCII apostrophe (assumed); amounts keep their comma separators as printed (the table rule compares them without commas). Arithmetic checked while typing (a throwaway script): in every transcribed firm row excess net capital (d) = adjusted net capital - net capital requirement (c), (g) = (e) - (f), (k) = (i) - (j) and (o) = (m) - (n), exactly; in the Totals row (g) = (e) - (f), (k) = (i) - (j) and (o) = (m) - (n), exactly. must_contain: 39 items: nine firm names of rows 16-63 (rows not in the table check), the two web-page-update labels of page 1 and 28 phrases from the page-2 notes, each printed once. Phrases avoid the apostrophes ('firm's', 'FCM's', 'Commission's'), the hyphenated words ('Self-Regulatory', 'non-customer', '15c3-1(a)') and the sentence 'This target amount is set by the firm.' (printed three times). ordered: five firm names in row order, the last update label, then the first and last notes of page 2. Noise: the print title is printed at the top of both pages; 'SELECTED FCM FINANCIAL DATA AS OF' and 'FROM REPORTS FILED BY' occur nowhere else, max 1 each (one kept copy is tolerated); the dates under them ('April 30, 2025', 'May 30, 2025') are too generic to count. Absent: no hyphenation, so absent is empty. BLIND PROTOCOL: chosen and answered before any converter or text extractor was run on the file; every check was typed from the rendered pages (pdftoppm at 70-300 dpi, read as images), and the PDF text layer was never read. Consequences: (1) text that may be an image (logos, seals, signatures, chart art) is not checked; (2) invisible text-layer content cannot be known, so noise lists only VISIBLE repeated page furniture; (3) where the exact code point of a glyph cannot be seen (curly vs straight quotes, dash and minus variants), must_contain phrases and ordered anchors avoid it; headings, table cells and absent entries that cannot avoid it are noted per file.
